notes:
tests/run_cost_basis_fop.js --stage

runs every node suite up to that stage, and fails on a missing file, a listed case the suite lacks, a case the suite has but this manifest does not list, an unknown stage, or zero selected cases.
Python suites are checked for their listed cases and run separately with unittest (§14.4).
A requirement tag with a parenthesised qualifier covers only that part of the F item; the item is complete only when its last dependent stage passes (§14.4).
